_comment: Free-text handbook passages. search_handbook() runs a deterministic keyword-overlap search over these, optionally filtered by jurisdiction. This is the local stand-in for the Week-5/6 Qdrant retriever: same role (find the prose of a rule), no Docker/ingest needed, so the race runs with one command.

passages.title: Primary Caregiver Leave eligibility matrix
passages.text: Primary caregiver paid leave scales with continuous service: under 12 months grants 8 weeks full pay, 12 to 36 months grants 14 weeks full pay, over 36 months grants 18 weeks full pay, each with an unpaid extension.

passages.title: Secondary Caregiver entitlement
passages.text: Secondary caregivers are eligible for 4 consecutive weeks of fully paid leave regardless of tenure, provided they have completed 90 calendar days of service.

passages.title: Primary Caregiver scale
passages.text: Primary caregiver paid duration: Category A under 6 months service grants 6 weeks full pay; Category B of 6 or more months grants 12 weeks full pay with 100% health continuation.

passages.title: Paternity and non-birthing support
passages.text: Non-birthing parents receive 15 consecutive calendar days of paid paternity leave.

passages.title: Annual Leave Accrual
passages.text: All full-time staff accrue annual leave at a standard rate of 1.75 days per completed calendar month of service.

passages.title: Probationary Employee Carry-Over Cap
passages.text: During active probation (under 6 months) Tier 1 staff may carry over at most 3 unused leave days and Tier 2 leads at most 5 days; confirmed employees over 6 months may carry over up to 10 days. Carry-over during probation requires manager approval.

passages.title: Probationary Restrictions
passages.text: Unconfirmed probationary employees under 6 months are prohibited from rolling over leave, with a carry-over cap of 0 days; confirmed employees may carry over a maximum of 5 days, expiring June 30th.

passages.title: Medical Certification Notification Matrix
passages.text: Sick absences of 1 to 7 days require only self-certification at 100% salary. Absences of 8 or more days require a Statement of Fitness for Work (GP Fit Note); pay is 100% for up to 4 weeks then 50% for the next 8 weeks.

passages.title: Personal Leave Accumulation Schedule
passages.text: Personal leave accrues at 10 fully paid days in service Year 1 and 12 fully paid days from Year 2 onward, with a carer's conversion cap of 5 days in Year 1 and 8 days thereafter.

passages.title: Unplanned Absence Evidence
passages.text: A medical certificate or statutory declaration is mandatory for personal leave exceeding 2 consecutive working days.
